info.description:
Modular OSINT & Cyber Threat Intelligence platform.

Every datum is labelled **verified**, **provider_claim** or **inferred**; anything not obtained is reported as an explicit provider run status. Nothing is sent to a third party unless a provider is selected in an enrichment request (see `/indicators/classify` for the plan).

post.description: Send the raw file as the request body (`Content-Type: application/octet-stream`), e.g. `curl --data-binary @sample.bin -H 'X-Filename: sample.bin' …`. Raw bodies are used instead of multipart so the server never spools an upload to disk. The bytes are streamed through MD5/SHA-1/SHA-256 and discarded. To look the hash up, submit it to `/enrich` explicitly.
